evidence: Cation-stoichiometric SrCoO3− ı thin ﬁlms were successfully grown in a commercial ALD reactor (F-120 by ASM Microchemistry Ltd.) using Sr(thd)2, Co(acac)3 and 10% ozone as precursors. Nitrogen (99.999%, 300 sccm, Schmidlin UHPN 3000 N generator) was used as the carrier and purge gas in the depositions with the background pressure of 2–3 mbar (1.5–2 Torr).
